title: Design: Opening the Customer chip panel leaves the table headings in place
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the asset's current owner.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, a payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, the asset's earlier owner.
  • Have a new asset for this test, asset 1, now owned by customer A, that earlier belonged to customer C, with work order 1 for customer C billing itself (made first, while customer C owned it) and work order 2 for customer A billed to customer B (made later), both at the test location.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p7-02-after-whole-history.png, bt-p7-03-after-customer-chip-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open asset 1's Work Orders tab from customer A's page.
  2. Take a screenshot of the page.
  3. Click the "Customer" filter chip.
  4. Click outside the panel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1, for customer C, and work order 2, for customer A, are listed, with a "Bill To" column reading customer B's name on work order 2.

Step 2:

  • You have a picture of where each heading, field and button sits before the change.

Step 3:

  • The panel opens over the table.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Step 4:

  • The panel closes; both work orders are still listed.
  • Every column heading is in the same place as in your screenshot: none has moved left or right.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12316 (Story 14, Asset Work Orders tab: whole history and Customer filter)

  • S14-R2: “A "Customer" filter chip sits beside Status, defaulting to "All customers".”
  • S14-R3: “Its options are every customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Whole history" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", This build), "Customer chip open" (page 7 "Asset Work Orders tab", New, no before exists). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p7-02-after-whole-history.png
  • bt-p7-03-after-customer-chip-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “Every work order on the asset at this location, for every owner and payer, oldest first as today: Kolosov's work orders now appear too.”
  • “"All customers" ticked, then "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow.", then each customer on the asset's work orders, as customer or Bill To, A to Z: "Kolosov's Diesel Repair", "Quartzsite Truck Service & Repair".”

The design's pictures with the panel closed and open (compared 13 Nov 2026) keep every visible heading at the same place.
